payload.title: Diagnostics and Integration
payload.summary: Compose bounded link-, network-, transport-, and application-layer parsing into deterministic offline diagnostics.

prerequisites: size_t, fixed-width integers, bit masks, and caller-owned buffers
outcomes: Integrate Ethernet, IPv4, transport, and application parsing in layer order
Keep every decoder inside its parent-defined byte window
Distinguish structural failures from unsupported protocols and checksum observations

payload.exercise: Implement the narrowing Ethernet-to-application diagnostic pipeline and queryable-capacity report formatting in exercise.c.
payload.reference: Use solution.c after implementing the partial-report and diagnostic/status distinctions from lesson.h.
checks: Ethernet to ARP, IPv4/ICMP, IPv4/UDP/DNS, and IPv4/TCP/HTTP paths
Checksum-valid fixture construction and checksum-mismatch observation
NUL termination for short buffers and bounded ordered layer reporting

allowed: Deterministic byte-array fixtures created by the test process
Caller-owned reports and bounded output buffers
In-memory fuzz inputs through the same bounded API
excluded: Sockets, external networking, raw capture, elevated privilege, or interface access
Allocation, mutable global state, or packed wire-structure casts
Production inspection features such as reassembly, TLS decryption, or arbitrary DNS graph traversal
